description: mta_sts_error.rs defines PolicyIdMismatch { cached, dns } which would be produced when the cached policy_id doesn't match the DNS id=. This variant is never produced — the comparison logic is absent (see stoa-w1h8x.3). The dead variant misleads contributors into thinking id-mismatch detection is implemented. Suggested rewrite: either implement it (fix stoa-w1h8x.3) or remove the variant until the feature is built.
title: MtaStsError::PolicyIdMismatch is defined but never constructed
